posts.author: peony__snow
posts.name: Rikka Botan / 六花牡丹(りっかぼたん)
posts.text:
MoE doesn't need a learned router!
Just send each token to the experts whose subspace it aligns with. 
ERMoE gives every expert an orthonormal eigenbasis and drops the load-balancing loss: +0.6pt ImageNet top-1 over V-MoE with 15% fewer params. (CVPR2026)

posts.author: peony__snow
posts.name: Rikka Botan / 六花牡丹(りっかぼたん)
posts.text:
Do looped Transformers really help, or just burn extra FLOPs?

SMELT (Tsinghua × ByteDance Seed) matches FLOPs, params & KV cache to find out.

Recipe: loop the middle half of MoE layers twice → 6.8–18% training-FLOP savings, growing with scale.
posts.card: arxiv.org SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers Looped Transformers increase effective depth by iterating a shared block of layers, but most evaluations compare at fixed mode
